463.1: The 248 positive commands that a person does do not bring one to do evil to creatures or to the Creator, happy is the one who observes them and maintains them. Such a person leaves the world in purity and clean deeds, corresponding to coming to this world in purity. About such a person the verse "blessed are you in your coming and blessed are you in your going" (Deuteronomy 28:6) is said, that your exit from this world should be without sin, just as your coming to this world.  And baruch (blessed) has the same gematria as hachi havey (thus you shall exist)
